subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should `/usage full` automatically include active-provider quota windows, and if approved, which lifecycle owner must prepare the snapshot before reply finalization?
rationale: The user value is established, but automatic quota text and snapshot ownership are product and hot-path architecture choices that the closed PRs did not settle.

options.title: Prepared snapshot footer
options.body: Approve the feature using a lifecycle-owned active-provider usage snapshot passed into the reply-usage contract, with no network fetch in footer formatting.

options.title: Status-only quotas
options.body: Keep provider quotas on `/status`, CLI, and Control UI surfaces and leave per-response footers limited to turn-local usage.

recommendation.title: Prepared snapshot footer
recommendation.body: Approve the feature using a lifecycle-owned active-provider usage snapshot passed into the reply-usage contract, with no network fetch in footer formatting.

likelyOwner.reason: Provider-usage history, current reply-usage blame, and prior issue scoping make this person the strongest available owner for this choice.
